message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol used on stock exchanges (and on Yahoo Finance) to represent **Microsoft Corporation**.  
On Yahoo Finance you can view its profile, price chart, financials, news, etc., by searching for “MSFT” or visiting:

[https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT)

If you need more specific data (price, volume, etc.) let me know!
